program_name: ESDC Opportunities Fund for Persons with Disabilities Regional Component
amount_notes: Up to $15,000,000 for projects up to 3 years. Average cost per participant approximately $12,000. Regional component covers 1-2 provinces. National component covers 3+ provinces.
eligibility_criteria: Must be an organization delivering employment programs to persons with disabilities
Must demonstrate capacity to serve minimum participant volumes with 60% success rate
Projects must deliver skills training, self-employment activities, or job placements
Must have Canada Revenue Agency business number
Must apply through Grants and Contributions Online Services (GCOS) portal
exclusions: CRITICAL: Funds organizations delivering programs — NOT individual entrepreneurs with disabilities
Individual persons with disabilities cannot apply directly
Adele and Sacral Solutions cannot apply directly — must access through a funded delivery organization
notes: IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: This program funds delivery organizations not individual entrepreneurs. An entrepreneur with a disability like thoracic outlet syndrome would access supports through an OF-funded delivery organization in their province. For Sacral Solutions research: find Saskatchewan organizations currently receiving OF funding that support entrepreneurs with disabilities. Currently receiving approximately $100M per year until 2026-2027 fiscal year. Self-employment and entrepreneurship are eligible activities under this program.
